editorial:
Imagine waking up one day and realizing you are no longer in control of your own mind. You are a respected doctor, but suddenly, the ghost of a dead killer has moved into your head. This movie puts you right in the middle of that nightmare. It mixes a creepy ghost story with a crime thriller, and the vibe is very tense. You get to see the doctor struggle to keep his life together while this evil spirit forces him to commit terrible crimes. It feels like a race against time as the doctor tries to figure out how to get rid of the ghost before he ends up in prison or worse.

The acting is surprisingly good for an old film, and the way they handle the split personality keeps you guessing. While some of the slow parts might feel dated, the twists make up for it. If you like old-school mysteries with a supernatural kick, you will love this.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up when the doctor finally finds a way to fight back against the spirit. After a series of tense confrontations, the ghost is forced out of his body for good. The mystery of the original murders is solved, and the doctor is cleared of any wrongdoing. You see him return to his normal life, finally free from the killer's voice, leaving you feeling relieved that the evil spirit is gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old ghost stories and crime puzzles.
